questions.prompt: How many points did Kobe Bryant score against Toronto on January 22, 2006?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 22, 2006, Bryant scored a career-high 81 points

funFacts.text: The Lakers trailed Toronto by 14 points at halftime before Kobe took over.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Lakers trailed 63–49 at halftime

funFacts.text: Bryant poured in 55 points after halftime alone.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with 55 points in the second half

funFacts.text: He played 42 minutes and knocked down seven threes during the explosion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant play 42 minutes, shooting 28-of-46 from the field, including 7-of-13 on three-pointers

questions.prompt: In Boston's 2008 title-clinching rout of Kobe's Lakers, how many points did Ray Allen and Kevin Garnett score together?
questions.context: Allen + Garnett · Celtics vs Lakers · 2008 Finals
questions.note: 52 points: Ray Allen and Kevin Garnett scored exactly 26 each.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Allen, Garnett 26 each
